"""A bare import and attribute chains at the use sites."""

import threetears.evals.host
import threetears.evals.kernel
import threetears.evals.schema as schema


def lease() -> float:
    return schema.DEFAULT_JOB_LEASE_S


def refuse() -> Exception:
    return threetears.evals.host.EvalServiceError("refused")


def kind() -> str:
    return threetears.evals.kernel.JUDGE_KIND
